heard: After millions of miles, this shuttle faced a traffic jam. It was built from spare structural parts left over from other orbiters. The massive journey across the city took 68 hours. Crews cut down over 400 trees to clear the wide wings. Workers pulled down traffic lights and shut off high-voltage power lines. The shuttle squeezed past apartment buildings with only inches of clearance. The spacecraft survived orbit, but city streets were its slowest mission yet.
